item.title: Missing Woman, Eleuthera Crash, Grand Lucayan Severance
item.ns0:title: Missing Woman, Eleuthera Crash, Grand Lucayan Severance
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, police investigate a fatal traffic collision on Eleuthera that claimed the life of a 59-year-old driver, while the search intensifies in Grand Bahama for a missing 75-year-old woman with Alzheimer's disease. Meanwhile, Foreign Affairs Minister Fred Mitchell addresses mounting frustration over overdue Grand Lucayan severance payments and reveals upcoming government plans for Freeport. Plus, tourism stakeholders gather aboard a Royal Caribbean cruise ship for high-level industry talks, local breast cancer survivors are honored at the Mall at Marathon, and a Bahamian filmmaking duo shares their vision for an inspiring new movie project. Tune in for all these stories, your weekend sports roundup, and the complete weekly weather forecast!
